test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters, that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

g h _ y _ t _ h k _ q t _ _ k _ q t

options.text: k y g q g h y
k q g y y h y
k q g y g h y
y q g k g h g

solution:
Given sequence: g h _ y _ t _ h k _ q t _ _ k _ q t

 
• k y g q g h y → g h **k** y **y** t - **g** h k **q** q t - **g** **h** k **y** q t
 
• k q g y y h y → g h **k** y **q** t - **g** h k **y** q t - <strong
